items.title: Primary Data Centers
items.content: Strategically located Tier-4 facilities ensuring low-latency access and data sovereignty compliance for enterprise clients.

items.title: Edge Compute Nodes
items.content: Over 200 points of presence (PoPs) globally for static asset caching and edge function execution.

items.title: Dedicated Connect
items.content: Private fiber links bypassing public internet congestion.

data.heading: Legacy Centralized Model
items: Single point of failure during regional outages.
Difficult to comply with strict data residency laws.
Easier to manage, but harder to scale globally.

data.heading: Our New Edge Topology
items: Sub-50ms latency for 95% of global users.
Data localized to comply with GDPR/CCPA natively.
Complex orchestration handled by automated IaC.

data.heading: Automated Deploy Script Refactoring
data.leftCode:
# Old way: manual scripts
ssh admin@server 'apt-get update && apt-get install docker'
scp config.json admin@server:/etc/app/
ssh admin@server 'docker-compose up -d'

questions.question: Which compliance framework mandates that personal data must remain within the borders of the European Union unless strict transfer mechanisms are in place?
options: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS)
questions.explanation: GDPR's data residency requirements are the primary driver behind our Phase 2 localized data silo rollout in the EMEA region.

items.detail: Every system designed assuming underlying hardware will eventually fail.
Zero-trust architecture implemented across all inter-service communications.
Providing self-serve tools for internal teams to deploy without DevOps bottlenecks.
Optimizing compute workloads to reduce our carbon footprint by 30%.

data.heading: Roadmap Milestones Recap
items: Q1-Q4 roadmap is fully funded and engineering teams are aligned.
Our move to Edge topology will provide a significant competitive advantage.
Compliance (GDPR, SOC2) is proactively integrated into the deployment pipeline.
Execution risk is mitigated through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
data.callToAction: Reach out to the PMO for detailed Gantt charts and resource allocations.
